Trim FASTQ files to the ITS region with ITSxpress before DADA2 denoising

Source: R/itsxpress_pq.R
itsxpress_pq.Rd

Run ITSxpress (Rivers et al. 2018; Einarsson & Rivers 2024) on paired-end or single-end FASTQ files to trim off the conserved ribosomal flanks (SSU, 5.8S, LSU) while preserving per-base Phred quality scores. Unlike itsx_pq(), which runs ITSx on already-denoised FASTA reference sequences in a phyloseq object, itsxpress_pq() operates directly on raw FASTQ reads before DADA2 denoising (filter_trim(), denoised_reads()).

By default (paired_end = TRUE and single_file_output = FALSE), itsxpress_pq() writes unmerged forward and reverse trimmed FASTQ files (--outfile and --outfile2), which is the layout required for DADA2's paired-end error model.

Usage

itsxpress_pq(
  path_to_fastq,
  folder_output = "itsxpress_output",
  region = c("ITS1", "ITS2", "ALL"),
  taxa = "Fungi",
  paired_end = TRUE,
  single_file_output = FALSE,
  cluster_id = 1,
  reversed_primers = FALSE,
  trim_ccs = FALSE,
  nproc = 1,
  pattern = "fastq.gz",
  pattern_R1 = "_R1",
  pattern_R2 = "_R2",
  nb_files = Inf,
  cmd_is_run = TRUE,
  return_file_path = FALSE,
  itsxpresspath = find_itsxpress(),
  args_before_itsxpress = "",
  extra_itsxpress_args = ""
)

Arguments

path_to_fastq

(required) Path to the directory containing FASTQ files. See list_fastq_files() for help.

folder_output

(default: "itsxpress_output") Path to the output directory where trimmed FASTQ files and per-sample logs are written.

region

(default: "ITS1") The ITS region to keep: "ITS1", "ITS2" or "ALL" (full ITS1 + 5.8S + ITS2).

taxa

(default: "Fungi") Taxonomic group sequenced (--taxa). One of "Fungi", "All", "Alveolata", "Bryophyta", "Bacillariophyta", "Amoebozoa", "Euglenozoa", "Chlorophyta", "Rhodophyta", "Phaeophyceae", "Marchantiophyta", "Metazoa", "Oomycota", "Haptophyceae", "Raphidophyceae", "Rhizaria", "Synurophyceae", "Tracheophyta", "Eustigmatophyceae", or "Parabasalia".

paired_end

(logical, default TRUE) Whether the input FASTQ files are paired-end.

single_file_output

(logical, default FALSE) Only used when paired_end = TRUE. If FALSE (default, required for downstream DADA2 paired-end denoising), itsxpress outputs unmerged R1 and R2 files via --outfile and --outfile2. If TRUE, itsxpress outputs a single merged FASTQ file per pair via --outfile.

cluster_id

(numeric, default 1.0) Percent identity in [0.99, 1.0] for clustering reads with VSEARCH (--cluster_id). Set to 1.0 (default) for exact dereplication when calling ASVs.

reversed_primers

(logical, default FALSE) If TRUE, pass --reversed_primers for primers in reverse orientation (Taylor et al. 2016).

trim_ccs

(logical, default FALSE) If TRUE, pass --trim-ccs for PacBio CCS long reads (only valid when paired_end = FALSE).

nproc

(integer, default 1) Number of processor threads (--threads).

pattern

a pattern to filter files (passed on to list.files function).

pattern_R1

a pattern to filter R1 files (default "R1")

pattern_R2

a pattern to filter R2 files (default "R2")

nb_files

the number of fastq files to list (default FALSE)

cmd_is_run

(logical, default TRUE) Whether to execute the itsxpress commands. If FALSE, the function only builds and returns a named list of shell commands.

return_file_path

(logical, default FALSE) If TRUE (when cmd_is_run = TRUE), return a list of output FASTQ file paths (fnfs and optionally fnrs), ready to be chained in a targets pipeline.

itsxpresspath

(default: find_itsxpress()) Path to the itsxpress executable.

args_before_itsxpress

(String, default "") A one-line bash command run before itsxpress, e.g. the conda activation string returned by install_itsxpress().

extra_itsxpress_args

(String, default "") Additional command-line flags passed verbatim to itsxpress.

Value

If cmd_is_run = FALSE, a named list of itsxpress shell commands. If return_file_path = TRUE, a named list of output file paths (fnfs, and fnrs when paired_end = TRUE and single_file_output = FALSE). Otherwise NULL invisibly, after running itsxpress.

References

Rivers AR, Weber KC, Gardner TG, Liu S, Armstrong SD (2018). ITSxpress: Software to rapidly trim internally transcribed spacer sequences with quality scores for marker gene analysis. F1000Research 7: 1418. doi:10.12688/f1000research.15704.1

Einarsson SV, Rivers AR (2024). ITSxpress version 2: software to rapidly trim internal transcribed spacer sequences with quality scores for amplicon sequencing. Microbiology Spectrum 12(4): e00601-24. doi:10.1128/spectrum.00601-24

See also

install_itsxpress(), is_itsxpress_installed(), find_itsxpress(), itsx_pq(), fastp(), cutadapt_remove_primers()

Author

Adrien Taudière

Examples

# Build paired-end ITSxpress commands without running them
itsxpress_pq(
  path_to_fastq = system.file("extdata", package = "MiscMetabar"),
  folder_output = file.path(tempdir(), "itsxpress_out"),
  region = "ITS2",
  cmd_is_run = FALSE
)
#> $`/tmp/RtmpwrUtcL/temp_libpath13913f132fe6a6/MiscMetabar/extdata/ex_R1_001.fastq.gz`
#> [1] "'itsxpress' --fastq '/tmp/RtmpwrUtcL/temp_libpath13913f132fe6a6/MiscMetabar/extdata/ex_R1_001.fastq.gz' --outfile '/tmp/Rtmp7j9BNw/itsxpress_out/ex_R1_001.fastq.gz' --region ITS2 --taxa Fungi --cluster_id 1 --threads 1 --log '/tmp/Rtmp7j9BNw/itsxpress_out/ex_R1_001.itsxpress.log' --fastq2 '/tmp/RtmpwrUtcL/temp_libpath13913f132fe6a6/MiscMetabar/extdata/ex_R2_001.fastq.gz' --outfile2 '/tmp/Rtmp7j9BNw/itsxpress_out/ex_R2_001.fastq.gz'"
#> 

# Run ITSxpress (the string returned by install_itsxpress() can be passed
# as `args_before_itsxpress` when it lives in a conda environment)
if (MiscMetabar::is_itsxpress_installed()) {
  itsxpress_pq(
    path_to_fastq = system.file("extdata", package = "MiscMetabar"),
    folder_output = file.path(tempdir(), "itsxpress_out"),
    region = "ITS1",
    taxa = "Fungi",
    nproc = 2
  )
}
